purpose: Separate device execution, server output readiness and client delivery; validate long-output dependent resident queues.
implementation_status: Node agent must add bounded launcher and server instrumentation; this JSON is not input to the old campaign CLI.

runtime.source: A100 80GB PCIe source; archived Sweden node preferred for direct timing reproduction
runtime.destination: A100 80GB PCIe destination; archived Germany node preferred for direct timing reproduction
runtime.power_limit_evidence: Measure both current power.limit values; archived final Germany evidence does not establish its cap. Record any change to 300 W.
runtime.portability: Matching full A100 80GB PCIe GPUs outside Azure can run this plan. One GPU suffices for warm-decode cells; source-active episodes require two separate GPU UUIDs, which may share a host if CPU/service interference is recorded. Preserve the proxy cap and measure transport/clock differences. Results on new hosts are a new environment, not direct validation of archived Germany timing. SXM or 40GB variants require separately labeled hardware calibration; do not silently pool their fits with PCIe 80GB.
runtime.coordinator_routing: The harness uses one cfg.host coordinator address: expose distinct source/destination serving and LMCache ports there, directly or via forwarding. Preserve coordinator-local proxy timestamps and attached source/sink stack logs.

budget.rule: Start only with whole-cell plus cleanup reserve; one global deadline includes setup, warmup, failures and cleanup. Record unstarted and censored cells. No performance retries.
budget.scope: Acquisition cap, not a runtime forecast; implement and test instrumentation before starting the GPU acquisition clock.

instrumentation_check.comparison: Matched cache state; off baselines agree within 5%, on agrees within 5% of the time-interpolated off baselines. Completion duration and output rate are client-observable in both modes.
instrumentation_check.request_contract: Use warm_decode_contract with O=256. Reuse the same eight prompts and output settings across off/on/off; clear owned native cache and repeat prewarming before each mode. Disable only new timing hooks, preserving the existing FIFO collector patch.
instrumentation_check.completion_duration: Median over the eight client dispatch-to-DONE durations.
instrumentation_check.output_rate: Total actual generated output tokens divided by (last client DONE minus first client dispatch), in seconds.

agentic_contract.workload_input: reference_plan.workloads[spec.workload], not the already sampled physical-workload.json
agentic_contract.execution: Reuse ResidentAcquisition.episode(spec, original_workload, 300, True) with new runtime-launch.json, fresh inventory and deadline.
agentic_contract.control_mirroring: Current harness releases the trajectory ownership lock before mirror work; preserve this and tag mirror work separately.
agentic_contract.service_outputs: Exact archived trajectory output lengths, including the 1233-token coding turn.
agentic_contract.migration_probe: Full retained-token /v1/completions probe: max_tokens 512, normal EOS. Preserve the agentic adapter; do not substitute the separate chat state-code probe. Keep generation separate from replay rebuild.
agentic_contract.holdout: All four new episodes are validation only; do not fit timing to their outcomes.

warm_decode_contract.host: destination role; a non-Azure matching GPU is allowed under runtime.portability
warm_decode_contract.invalid_cell_policy: Retain measured cache misses, preemptions, failures and partial outputs; do not certify the warm condition or fit it as Q=32. Never replace them with zero-cost work.
warm_decode_contract.before_each_cell: Verify the owned GPU/stack is idle, reset owned native prefix cache, then prewarm only this cell; all setup is inside the whole-cell cap.

required_telemetry.identity: Host, GPU UUID, PID, boot/time namespace, monotonic clock domain, paired wall/monotonic anchors, launch flags and hashes of actually imported patched modules.
required_telemetry.scheduler: Iteration ID; request IDs; prompt and output counts; computed tokens BEFORE scheduling; scheduled Q; native/external cache counts; running/waiting, remote-KV waits and preemptions; host schedule start/end.
required_telemetry.worker: Same iteration ID; CUDA-event forward/logits/sampling elapsed times and output-ready host timestamp after existing output-copy synchronization; emitted request IDs and token ordinals.
required_telemetry.frontend: External/internal request-ID mapping; server ingress; output-processor receipt; collector put/pop or SSE yield with token ordinals and host timestamps.
required_telemetry.client: Existing request dispatch, raw SSE receive events, exact token counts, usage, completion/failure/censoring and offered-arrival timestamps.
required_telemetry.engine: Existing running/waiting, KV-cache, prefix-cache, preemption, GPU utilization/power/clocks telemetry at the archived sampling cadence.
required_telemetry.rules: Join IDs across asynchronous batches; no extra per-step global CUDA synchronize. CUDA-event elapsed remains relative GPU-stream time in its own clock domain, not a host timestamp or exclusive kernel busy time. SSE yield is not wire flush. Subtract host timestamps only after verifying a common clock domain; never subtract different-host monotonic clocks.

acceptance: Zero dropped telemetry records; every offered request and observed scheduled/generated token is represented, including failed or censored requests.
Iteration/request/token-ordinal joins resolve; sum of scheduled Q per iteration is at most 8192; actual outputs agree with complete final usage.
Controlled warm cells certify native prefix hits and zero external hits, output 1536 and no context overflow; any failed condition stays visible and is excluded from the intended warm fit.
Agentic physical-workload and offered-trace hashes reproduce their frozen references exactly.
Report device execution, server-ready decode, frontend/client delivery and causal queue wait separately; explain the 1233-token coding turn and long-replay burst with evidence.
Keep previous fit and heldout tolerances frozen while collecting; publish data-quality outcomes before proposing any recalibration. Policy ranking is not an acceptance criterion.
return_artifacts: Frozen plan, git revision, fresh runtime-launch and inventory, launch commands, model/tokenizer and imported module hashes, instrumentation patch/source copies.
All raw scheduler/worker/frontend/client event streams, offered traces, physical workloads, request/migration histories, engine and power logs.
Off/on/off overhead comparison, optional short native profile, per-cell summaries and report including failed/censored/unstarted cells and completeness checks.
SHA256 manifest; compressed raw archives allowed only with verified member hashes and a working reducer.
remaining_cpu_work: Integrate calibrated GPU-local resident queues/KV placement and causal source queues; validate all policies and bounded sensitivities before removing the full-campaign readiness guard.
